title: 第一卷 第14章 收获不菲
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华和阿青俩人网兜里的海货，直接装了大半蛇皮袋。

    鼓鼓囊囊的。

    阿青高兴坏了，喊道：“哥，咱们居然抓了这么多海鲜，肯定能卖很多钱啊。”

    “太好了。”

    “换张大雷的债，有戏，有戏。”

    李华笑着点点头。

    张春妮抬起头看过来。

    她跟着也抓了不少海鲜，可是和这俩人一比，差距还是挺大的。

    没办法。

    有些礁石，她搬不动。

    也不敢喊李华帮忙，就只能想办法把海鲜从礁石缝隙或者礁石下面抓出来，耽误了不少功夫。

    李华把蛇皮袋搬到水洼里放着。

    主要还是虾蟹居多。

    虾蟹本来就不容易死，有水的话，到摊贩那边卖的时候，应该也还是活蹦乱跳的。

    一共三个蛇皮袋。

    还有两个蛇皮袋里分别放了青蟹和海参，青蟹有五个，其中三个是阿青抓的。

    海参就多了。

    李华没仔细数，粗略看有五十多个，最小的也有三两，大只的少说有一斤，加起来不会少于三十斤。

    他对海参的市场价不太了解，但不会比青蟹差。

    之前张海洋给他的青蟹单价是一斤25，那最少就是六百块钱。

    这只是保守估计。

    阿青看着水洼里的蛇皮袋，说道：“哥，就放在这里能行吗？”

    李华说道：“今天不是大潮。”

    “潮水退不了多远。”

    “咱们时刻关注着，问题不大。”

    阿青点点头：“行，我看也没人来这边赶海，嘿嘿，挺好，都便宜咱们了。”

    李华：“继续找吧。”

    他要搬石头。

    阿青赶紧过来帮忙：“哥，我来，我来。”

    李华没拒绝。

    阿青是个实在人。

    他运气不好，找不到海鲜，就觉得自己拖后腿，这样搬石头，出出力，心里好受。

    搬开石头。

    两个海参趴在一起，微微蠕动，也不知道干啥呢。

    阿青高兴坏了。

    他自己也试着找。

    结果和刚才一样，一连搬了俩礁石，别说海参了，就连个海螺都没找到，他说道：“哥，要不你指挥我吧。”

    “我这手气太臭。”

    “太耽误挣钱了。”

    李华说道：“行，我指挥。”

    这样一来，他也能腾出手多关照关照张春妮。

    阿青问道：“哥，你看看往哪边找？”
content_en:
Most of the seafood in Li Hua and Ah Qing's net pockets was filled with snakeskin bags.

    Bulging.

    Ah Qing was so happy that he shouted: "Brother, we caught so much seafood, we must be able to sell it for a lot of money."

    "Great."

    "In exchange for Zhang Dalei's debt, there is a play, there is a play."

    Li Hua smiled and nodded.

    Zhang Chunni raised her head and looked over.

    She also caught a lot of seafood, but compared with these two people, the gap was still quite big.

    no way.

    There were some rocks that she couldn't move.

    He didn't dare to call Li Hua for help, so he could only find a way to catch the seafood from the cracks or under the rocks, which wasted a lot of time.

    Li Hua moved the snakeskin bag to the puddle and put it there.

    Mainly shrimps and crabs.

    Shrimps and crabs are not easy to die. If there is water, they should still be alive and kicking when they are sold by the vendors.

    There are three snakeskin bags in total.

    There were also two snakeskin bags containing blue crabs and sea cucumbers respectively. There were five blue crabs, three of which were caught by Ah Qing.

    There are more sea cucumbers.

    Li Hua didn't count carefully. At a rough glance, there were more than fifty. The smallest one weighed only three taels. The big one weighed at least one kilogram. The total would not be less than thirty kilograms.

    He doesn’t know much about the market price of sea cucumbers, but it’s no worse than blue crabs.

    The unit price of blue crabs that Zhang Haiyang gave him before was 25 yuan per catty, which was at least 600 yuan.

    This is just a conservative estimate.

    Ah Qing looked at the snakeskin bag in the puddle and said, "Brother, can you just leave it here?"

    Li Hua said: "Today is not a big tide."

    "The tide doesn't go out very far."

    "We are keeping an eye on it and it's not a big problem."

    Ah Qing nodded: "Okay, I don't see anyone coming here to catch the sea. Hehe, it's good. It gives us an advantage."

    Li Hua: "Keep looking."

    He wants to move rocks.

    Ah Qing hurried over to help: "Brother, I'll come, I'll come."

    Li Hua did not refuse.

    Ah Qing is a real person.

    He was unlucky and couldn't find any seafood, so he felt like he was being held back. He felt good about moving rocks and doing his best.

    Remove the stone.

    The two sea cucumbers were lying together, squirming slightly, not knowing what they were doing.

    Ah Qing was so happy.

    He also tried to find it himself.

    The result was the same as before, two rocks were moved in a row, not to mention sea cucumbers, not even a conch was found. He said: "Brother, how about you command me."

    "My luck is so bad."

    "It's such a delay in making money."

    Li Hua said, "Okay, I'll take command."

    In this way, he can also free up his hands to take more care of Zhang Chunni.

    Ah Qing asked: "Brother, where are you looking?"
